latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the Paper Title Generator skill.
- Generates 3–5 optimized paper titles per specified academic venue (IEEE Transactions, IFAC, ACC, CDC, Automatica, etc.), each with style rationale, tone tags, and word count.
- Supports multiple input formats: full draft, abstract, key points, method/algorithm name, and target venue(s).
- Applies detailed, venue-specific title style guidelines for academic publishing.
- Explains title choices, highlights red flags, and offers a structured workflow for responsive, high-quality suggestions.
